docuoria — the Docuoria local host: an MCP server for your AI tools.

Usage:
  docuoria init   [path] [--tools <list>] [--store account|folder] [--service <url>] [--no-interactive]
  docuoria update [path]
  docuoria list-tools
  docuoria serve  [--project <dir>] [--http <port>]
  docuoria store push [dir] [--service <url>]
  docuoria login  [--service <url>] [--organisation <id|name>] [--local-signin]
  docuoria logout [--service <url>]
  docuoria account show | associate <code> | seats add <n> | seats retire <seat-id> | reconcile | upgrade [--plan <plan>] [--seats <n>]
                   [--organisation <id|name>] [--service <url>] [--local-signin]
  docuoria account keys create --label <name> [--service <url>] [--local-signin]
  docuoria doctor
  docuoria license <status|set|remove>
  docuoria version
  docuoria help

         Required when stdin is not a terminal or --no-interactive is given.
         Run 'docuoria list-tools' to see available IDs.

--service  The Docuoria service URL (default https://api.docuoria.com).
